requirements.statement: Bind objective, subject, source, architecture, AMCAS, policies, identities, locality, software generation and journal head in one exact baseline.
Do not treat completion as acceptance; require a policy-bound external signed approval for an accepted milestone.
Carry every unresolved work item into a successor plan with an explicit retained, resolved or deferred disposition.
Keep exact state, meaning, governance, locality, receipts and complete-body commitments distinct.
Treat DKN locality and MosaicID descriptors as commitments, never capability or namespace grants.

Bind the executable, runner, dependency closure, inputs, environment, policies, authority, jurisdiction, effects, history paths, adapter and producer-operation identity before terminal-receipt reuse or artifact supersession.
Schedule standards reviews from meaningful project events and explicit invalidations rather than blind periodic reminders.
Report implemented, tested, reviewed and accepted status separately from journal-derived facts without unsupported maturity percentages.
Keep effect authorization, executor admission and terminal effect custody in the courthouse or other admitted external executor.
